PROTEST FOR THE WIDESPREAD TREE-CUTTING

LOOK: Environmentalists from Kalikasan People's Network for the Environment and other civil society organizations gather along Quirino Avenue, Malate, Manila, on May 26, to protest the widespread tree-cutting underway for the 40.62-kilometer Southern Access Link Expressway (SALEX) project. | 📸: Niño Jesus Orbeta, Philippine Daily Inquirer
